consumerKey.title: Consumer Key
consumerKey.description: Consumer key provided when you setup your Salesforce connected app

consumerSecret.title: Consumer Secret
consumerSecret.description: Consumer secret provided when you setup your Salesforce connected app

salesforceApiVersion.title: Salesforce API Version
salesforceApiVersion.description: API version of the Salesforce instance

salesforceDomain.title: Salesforce Domain
salesforceDomain.description: My Domain of the Salesforce org, without `.salesforce.com`, e.g. `mycompany.my` or `mycompany--sandbox.sandbox.my`. The OAuth client credentials flow only works on the org's My Domain, so `login` and `test` are rejected.

data360DbServiceName.title: Data 360 Database Service Name
data360DbServiceName.description: Name of the Data 360 database service to use for lineage resolution

serviceMapping.title: Service Mapping
serviceMapping.description: JSON object mapping a Data 360 connector or data source name to the OpenMetadata service that holds it, used to resolve the upstream entity of a Data Stream. Example: {"S3_Connector": "my-s3-service"}

includeBulkLineage.title: Include Bulk Lineage
includeBulkLineage.description: Optional configuration to toggle the ingestion of Data Lake Object to Data Model Object lineage for every dataspace. This walks all Data Model Objects in the configured Data 360 database service, so it is off by default.

paginationLimit.title: Pagination Limit
paginationLimit.description: Pagination limit used when fetching Data 360 objects. The default value is 10, and the valid range is 1-200

supportsLineageExtraction.title: Supports Lineage Extraction
supportsLineageExtraction.$comment: Lineage and run status are extracted by the metadata agent, as for every other pipeline service. Kept, defaulting to false, so stored connections still validate and the UI and AutoPilot stop offering separate Lineage and Usage agents.
